summary: Enable the MCP server from Settings: Extensions > Ansible settings wheel > Settings > Extensions > Ansible > MCP Server, tick 'Enable the Ansible development tools MCP server for AI integration', then use MCP: List servers to start it and look for 'Discovered 10 tools'.
questions: How do I enable the Ansible MCP server in VS Code settings?
Where is the MCP Server setting for the Ansible extension?
Enable the Ansible development tools MCP server for AI integration checkbox
